name: Strategy
description: Strategy comes first: one working session and a short brief that decides what each page is for. On its own it starts at $1,500; inside a website project it is included.

name: Web design
description: I match the build to your budget and to whoever will maintain it after launch. Everything is built mobile-first and tested for accessibility from the very first screen, then handed off so you are never locked out of your own site.

name: Photography
description: When the photographer and the designer are one person, the photos match the layout instead of fighting it. Images arrive edited, web-optimized, and ready to drop in.

acceptedAnswer.text: Websites start at $4,000 for a focused Launch site. A larger Signature site typically runs $7,000 to $11,000, and builds with real custom functionality start around $12,000. Every build is custom and comes with a content system you can manage yourself; what moves the number is scope, functionality, photography, and content. The first conversation is free and ends with a ballpark before either of us is committed, and larger projects can be split into monthly payments so the budget is about cash flow, not one big wall.

mainEntity.name: What if I have been quoted less somewhere else?

acceptedAnswer.text: You probably can find a cheaper quote, and for a very simple need that might be the right call. What a low quote usually leaves out is the part that matters later: accessibility, a content system your team can actually run, a plan for who maintains the site after launch, and someone who still answers the phone in a year. A site you have to rebuild in eighteen months is the expensive one. I would rather build it once.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most websites land between six and ten weeks from kickoff to launch. Larger projects with custom photography or multiple content collections can run twelve to sixteen weeks. The brief at the end of strategy sets the real timeline.

Optional. After launch you own the site outright and can leave it alone for years if nothing breaks. If you want hands-on support, care plans start at $100 a month for updates, backups, and security, with higher tiers that add a monthly bucket of content edits.

mainEntity.name: Can you work with my existing brand?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If you already have a logo, palette, and type system, I use it. If you do not, brand work can be folded into the strategy phase or scoped separately.

mainEntity.name: Where are you based, and do you work with clients outside Cincinnati?

acceptedAnswer.text: I'm based in Cincinnati, but web design, strategy, and brand work happen with clients anywhere, fully remote when that is easier. Photography is the one piece that needs me on site, so that stays within the greater Cincinnati region.
